jyutping: V dak1 mou4 mou4 wu4 wu4

english.note: Use this when something is perceived, remembered, or described indistinctly rather than sharply.

examples.english: I remember unclearly that it seemed to be raining that day.
examples.traditional: 我記得模模糊糊，嗰日好似落緊雨。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gei3 dak1 mou4 mou4 wu4 wu4 go2 jat6 hou2 ci5 lok6 gan2 jyu6
